description: Mirror of character-pack.schema.json from the advertiser side. A template pack is a creative plus a binding contract: it declares WHERE the user's character may be composed (slots), WHAT the composer is allowed to do (binding rules), what renders without consent (fallback), and what counts as a verified impression. Raw faces never enter this contract — only character-pack references. v1.1.0: two-axis consent, consent classes, instance TTL, age gate, placement mode, personalization level.

age_gate.description: Kids safety: personalization is deny-by-default for minors.

require_age_attestation.description: When true, the runtime must have an age attestation before composing any personalization.

max_impressions_per_user.description: Frequency cap on ALL serves (personalized or fallback). Survival condition for the format.

max_personalized_impressions_per_user.description: Brand safety both ways: after N personalized serves, further serves use fallback.

min_assets.description: Asset kinds the composer needs from the user's character pack.

require_original_design.description: User character pack must attest character.original_design = true.

compose.description: On-device composer policy. The composed instance is ephemeral by design.

instance_max_serves.description: A composed instance is deleted after N serves, whichever comes first with TTL.

instance_ttl_min.description: Time-to-live of a composed personalized instance. After TTL it is deleted.

media_retention.description: The log keeps hashes, never media. The composed pixels never leave the device and are not stored past TTL.

consent.description: Two-axis consent contract. Axis 1 (temporal): how long. Axis 2 (target): whom it covers. Both must be satisfied for a personalized serve.

classes_required.description: Which consent classes this template needs. profile_token = name/city (text layer). likeness_binding = character-ref composition. Separate switches, never one.

targets.description: Which consent targets this template accepts. global = user allowed this sponsor everywhere; advertiser = this sponsor; campaign = this campaign only.

temporal_scopes.description: single_request = one serve, then ask again.

duration_sec.description: Max on-screen time. The consent request shows this number to the user.

sha256.description: Content-addressed creative. The composer must verify the hash before composing.

type.description: trailer uses the same slot mechanism as ad; only the creative type differs.

disclosure.description: Runtime ad labeling. Always rendered by the runtime, never optional.

synthetic_media_flag.description: Marks AI-composited personalization for platform synthetic-media policies.

fallback.description: INVARIANT P1: no fallback in the pack -> validator rejects, pack is not accepted. What renders when consent is denied, revoked, expired, or no character pack is available.

manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of this manifest, excluding this field. Content-addresses the contract itself.

personalization_level.description: Max personalization level this template uses. 1 = text tokens only (profile_token). 2 = character composition (likeness_binding). Quick filter for rollout and policy.

slots.description: Personalization slots: the ONLY places where the user's character or profile tokens may appear. Anything not declared here is forbidden.

binding_rules.description: Character-consistency guardrails: the character must stay itself.

max_scale.description: Upper bound on upscaling the character asset inside the slot.

character_role.description: Role the user's character plays in this slot.

kind.description: character_anchor = user's character composited into the frame (on-device). name_token/text_token = text-layer personalization, level 1.

placement_mode.description: XR placement of the slot. head_locked = glued to view; world_locked = anchored in space. Declared, not guessed.

region.description: Normalized 0..1 frame region for character_anchor slots.

sponsor_id.description: Advertiser identifier in the ad network.

verification.description: Definition of a verified impression. Mirrors xr-event.schema.json thresholds.

billable_event.description: Only ImpressionValidated WITH evidence counts. No evidence, no billing (I3).

dismiss_counts_as.description: Swipe-dismiss (GestureInteraction/close) ends the session: no billable impression.

min_coverage_pct.description: Minimum timeline_coverage_pct for the impression to bill.

min_dwell_ms.description: Floor matches xr-event.schema.json: 1200 ms billable attention threshold.

title: Ad Template Pack v1.1 — advertiser template with personalization slots (DRAFT)
